title: Grateful Dead Live at The Spectrum on 1973-09-21

ai_review.summary: Audience tape of a long, high‑energy 9/21/73 show with standout “Casey Jones”; recording is incomplete and cut short.
ai_review.review: The performance is described by reviewers as a "freaking smoke" night with new horn players that added excitement, highlighted by a strong rendition of Casey Jones. The source appears to be an audience tape that suffers from a mid‑song cutoff, limiting its technical quality despite the enthusiastic musical content.

ai_rating.rationale: Show is praised for energy and unique horns (70% weight), but recording suffers from a noticeable cut, lowering overall enjoyment (30% weight).

recording_quality.technical_notes: Tape source; one track is truncated halfway through the second chorus, resulting in an incomplete listening experience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Long marathon set (7 pm‑2 am) with new horn players adding fresh textures; exact flow unclear.
